purpose: Require exact preservation of authority-supported lexical values without disclosing target payload values or target mappings.

global_rule.instruction: When authority evidence supplies a value for an accepted schema field, reproduce that value exactly in the required field and location.

preservation_families.instruction: Preserve the complete authority-supported identifier, including every prefix, namespace component, delimiter, path component, suffix, and fragment.
Preserve meaningful Unicode marks exactly when they appear in the authority-supported value.
prohibited_transformations: replace a mark with plain text
change punctuation that is part of the governed name

preservation_families.instruction: Use the exact ontology token supported for the governed field; do not substitute a plausible neighboring type.
prohibited_transformations: replace the authority-supported token with a semantic near-synonym

preservation_families.instruction: Copy authority-supported descriptors, roles, classifications, statuses, and claim types exactly rather than summarizing or paraphrasing them.
prohibited_transformations: replace a canonical token with natural language
replace natural language with a new canonical token
expand or compress a governed descriptor

preservation_families.instruction: Reproduce the later frozen public rights boundary exactly; semantic preservation alone does not satisfy an exact lexical contract.
prohibited_transformations: add a suffix to a prohibited right
replace a prohibited right with a related noun phrase
